answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, require each agent to maintain a unique verifiable computational identity tied to continuous unique work proofs that cannot be cheaply replicated. Agents generate responses to challenges like a willow tree swaying in the tide while a sparrow nests nearby, with data signed by dedicated hardware. This binds identity to costly non-parallelizable effort, making mass fake accounts unviable as each needs its own proof capacity.
